listing_assets_dimensions_positive.name: listing_assets_dimensions_positive
listing_assets_dimensions_positive.value: ("app"."listing_assets"."width" is null or "app"."listing_assets"."width" > 0) and ("app"."listing_assets"."height" is null or "app"."listing_assets"."height" > 0)

listings_unconfirmed_state_valid.name: listings_unconfirmed_state_valid
listings_unconfirmed_state_valid.value: "app"."listings"."original_sponsorship_paise" is not null or ("app"."listings"."confirmed_total_paise" = 0 and "app"."listings"."current_total_reached_at" is null and "app"."listings"."first_confirmed_at" is null)

financial_ledger_entry_sign_valid.name: financial_ledger_entry_sign_valid
financial_ledger_entry_sign_valid.value: ("private"."financial_ledger"."entry_type" in ('initial_sponsorship', 'raise', 'refund_restoration', 'chargeback_restoration') and "private"."financial_ledger"."amount_delta_paise" > 0) or ("private"."financial_ledger"."entry_type" in ('refund', 'chargeback') and "private"."financial_ledger"."amount_delta_paise" < 0) or "private"."financial_ledger"."entry_type" = 'admin_financial_correction'

financial_ledger_fulfilment_attempt_requ.name: financial_ledger_fulfilment_attempt_required
financial_ledger_fulfilment_attempt_requ.value: "private"."financial_ledger"."entry_type" not in ('initial_sponsorship', 'raise') or "private"."financial_ledger"."payment_attempt_id" is not null

payment_attempts_target_snapshot_valid.name: payment_attempts_target_snapshot_valid
payment_attempts_target_snapshot_valid.value: ("private"."payment_attempts"."target_total_paise_snapshot" is null or ("private"."payment_attempts"."target_total_paise_snapshot" >= 0 and "private"."payment_attempts"."target_total_paise_snapshot" % 100 = 0)) and ("private"."payment_attempts"."target_rank_snapshot" is null or "private"."payment_attempts"."target_rank_snapshot" > 0) and ("private"."payment_attempts"."estimated_rank_snapshot" is null or "private"."payment_attempts"."estimated_rank_snapshot" > 0)

payment_attempts_actor_valid.name: payment_attempts_actor_valid
payment_attempts_actor_valid.value: ("private"."payment_attempts"."purpose" = 'initial_sponsorship' and "private"."payment_attempts"."pending_owner_id" is not null) or ("private"."payment_attempts"."purpose" = 'raise' and "private"."payment_attempts"."requested_by_user_id" is not null and "private"."payment_attempts"."pending_owner_id" is null)

payment_attempts_fulfilment_state_valid.name: payment_attempts_fulfilment_state_valid
payment_attempts_fulfilment_state_valid.value: "private"."payment_attempts"."state" <> 'succeeded' or ("private"."payment_attempts"."fulfilled_ledger_entry_id" is not null and "private"."payment_attempts"."succeeded_at" is not null)

pending_listing_owners_claim_fields_vali.name: pending_listing_owners_claim_fields_valid
pending_listing_owners_claim_fields_vali.value: "private"."pending_listing_owners"."claim_state" <> 'claimed' or ("private"."pending_listing_owners"."claimed_by_user_id" is not null and "private"."pending_listing_owners"."claimed_at" is not null)
